summary_short: Krishna explains His divine nature, material and spiritual energies, and why people struggle to recognize Him.
summary_medium: Krishna reveals complete knowledge — both theoretical and realized — explaining His material and spiritual energies, the role of the three gunas, and why only a few seek Him sincerely.
summary_detailed: Krishna promises complete knowledge without remainder.
Material and spiritual energies are explained.
The entire universe is sustained by the Divine.
The three gunas bind the soul.
Four types of people seek God.
The wise devotee is declared supreme.
what_you_learn: Difference between material and spiritual energy.
